notes: Boot elvis (5.00) with four balls on trough switches 11-14 and the stacking opto 15 at 0, built-in mechanisms off. Enter the Switch Test as in elvis-switch-test and, for 63 (a control), 64 and 3 in turn: close the switch for 3 s, open it for 3 s and pulse it for 100 ms, reading the display every 0.25 s, to see when and on which edge the ROM prints each name.
